title: Sunday in Mong Kok
author: mikkl-yiu
text: Filipino domestic workers sharing food, talking and resting along the footbridges in Mong Kok, Hong Kong.

media.alt: People sitting on mats and sharing food along a covered footbridge in Mong Kok, Hong Kong.
media.caption: Photographed on Sunday, May 26, 2024.

media.alt: People walking through the middle of a covered footbridge, with groups seated along both sides in Mong Kok.
People resting on cardboard and sitting beside bags along a covered walkway in Mong Kok.
